card.name: Linking words before space agency names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as the, aboard, with, of and 's just before a named space mission, telescope, observatory or large institution. Mostly in astronomy and science news text.

modes.label: Before telescope or agency
modes.description: A linking word right before a named space telescope, agency or science facility.
modes.example: The sharp vision and ultraviolet sensitivity of the Wide Field Camera 3 aboard<< the>> NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope were

modes.label: Before geographic or imperial names
modes.description: A word before a large place or empire name.
modes.example: making it the largest continuous reef in the<< Western>> Hemisphere.

card.writes: It seems to suppress odd tokens and push toward word starts like pan, trans and Pan, with no clear link to the context.
card.plain: It fires on little words that come just before the name of a space telescope, agency or big institution.
